pageTitle: Oklahoma Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: What Are the Requirements to Buy Lottery Tickets in Oklahoma?
items.answer:
Persons must be 18 or older to play. Oklahoma lottery tickets can be bought from authorized retailers all over the state. No online ticket sales are possible. An Oklahoma lottery app is available, but its functionality is limited to checking Oklahoma lottery results, generating random numbers, and checking your numbers.

 

The app is not an Oklahoma lottery ticket scanner for checking draw or scratch tickets or Oklahoma lottery codes.

items.question: What Lottery Games Can You Play in Oklahoma?
items.answer:
The lottery in Oklahoma offers six different games. In addition to Mega Millions and Oklahoma lottery Powerball, you can play Oklahoma Lottery

Lucky for Life.

The following games are available to Okies as well:

Lotto America – features a rolling jackpot that starts at $2 million

Pick 3 – Pick three single-digit numbers and choose from multiple ways to win

Cash 5 – Choose five numbers from 1 to 36 and attempt to win $25 000

items.question: Where and How Do I Claim Winnings from the Oklahoma Lottery?
items.answer: If you matched the Oklahoma lottery numbers, you could redeem your tickets at the Oklahoma Lottery’s office in Oklahoma City or any of the twelve claim centres across the state. You can claim prizes of $600 or less from your local participating retailer.

items.question: How Do You Play and Win in the Oklahoma Lottery?
items.answer: Each of the six lottery games has a specific range of Oklahoma Lottery numbers. For instance, Cash 5 lets you pick five numbers between 1 and 36. The aim is to correctly guess which of these five numbers will appear in the draw. You can also win a cash prize for as little as two matching Oklahoma Lottery winning numbers.

items.question: What Are the Odds of Winning the Oklahoma Lottery?
items.answer:
The odds of winning the various games available from the Oklahoma State Lottery are as follows:

Mega Millions: 1 in 302 million

Powerball: 1 in 175 million

Lucky for Life: 1 in 31 million

Lotto America: 1 in 26 million

Pick 3: 1 in 1000

Cash 5: 1 in 377 000

items.question: What’s the Biggest Oklahoma Lottery Win?
items.answer: The biggest Oklahoma Lottery winners hit the Powerball jackpot in 2007 when Don and Joyce Harvey won $106 million.

items.question: When Is the Oklahoma Lottery Results Draw?
items.answer:
You can view the draw results of the Oklahoma Lottery games at the following times:

Lotto America: Wednesdays and Saturdays at 10 pm

Lucky for Life: Mondays and Thursdays at 9 pm

Pick 3 and Cash 5: Daily at 9 pm

items.question: What Is the Oklahoma Lottery Second Chance?
items.answer: Oklahoma state lottery offers promotional Oklahoma lottery second chance drawings on Oklahoma lottery scratch games. Players need to register on the official lottery website in order to participate. Once a player has an account, eligible tickets can be entered for prizes like cash, merchandise, and vacations

items.question: Do I Have to Pay Tax on Oklahoma Lottery Winnings?
items.answer:
Yes. If you win more than $600, then the Oklahoma Lottery will keep a specific percentage of these winnings for federal and state tax purposes as follows:

 

State tax is 4%

Federal tax is 24%

Total tax is 28.%
